name: India: Model Building Bye-Laws 2016 (TCPO, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)

review.note: A model: states and cities issue the binding bye-laws, often based on it, and numbers vary by city. NBC 2016 was withdrawn on 2026-04-30 (replaced by the voluntary NBCS 2026). Light: 1/10 in hot-dry climates (1/6 warm-humid, 1/8 intermediate, 1/12 cold). The handrail rule has only a minimum (900), so it is not checked. Not checked by this pack: handrail height. Room size, hallway, egress door and…
